'''Star Tours Flight 1347''' was the designation of a flight offered to passengers by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency around the time of the [[Battle of Death Star III]]. It was scheduled to arrive from [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] at Gate 29 at the time.
